title: Military members saw football-field-size triangular craft

tellings.quote: I remember sort of interviewing some military members that saw some really profound stuff like, you know, large, you know, triangular crafts, you know, football field size that, you know, hovered over them.

plain: Military members saw huge triangular craft, "football field size", hovering right over them, according to a former US intelligence officer named David Grusch, who says he interviewed some of these service members between about 2019 and 2021. He tells Michels they "saw some really profound stuff", and if their accounts are accurate, very large unknown craft have been flying low over American military personnel.
